tasks.label: Project: Setup
tasks.detail: Install dependencies and build core packages (@repo/data-ops)

tasks.label: Types: Generate Worker Bindings
tasks.command: pnpm run --filter user-application cf-typegen && pnpm run --filter data-service cf-typegen

tasks.label: DB: Build Data Ops (Required after Schema change)
tasks.detail: Rebuild @repo/data-ops package to propagate schema changes

tasks.label: DB: Generate Migration
tasks.detail: Generate a new SQL migration file after schema changes

tasks.label: DB: Apply Migration (Local D1)
tasks.command: cd apps/user-application && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=$(ls -t ../../packages/data-ops/src/drizzle/*.sql | head -n 1)
tasks.detail: Apply the latest migration to the local D1 database using wrangler

tasks.label: DB: Apply Migration (Production D1)
tasks.command: cd apps/user-application && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
tasks.detail: Apply pending migrations to the production Cloudflare D1 database

tasks.label: Check: Quality Gate (Lint, Typecheck, Test)
tasks.command: npx nx run-many -t lint typecheck test
tasks.detail: Run all verification checks across the workspace

tasks.label: Check: Run All Tests
tasks.detail: Run all Vitest tests across the workspace

tasks.label: Check: Lint All
tasks.detail: Run linter across all workspace packages

tasks.label: Check: Typecheck All
tasks.detail: Run TypeScript compiler check across all workspace packages
